== Build notes ==
The [[Main Page]] tile for this set is the first panel of the official title strip (a planet). Later panels of the same official GIF are Count Dooku, a snow village, Quinlan Vos, a temple, and Obi-Wan Kenobi. A Dooku trial crop is [[:File:Set-V26-dooku-trial.jpg]]. Full strip: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/SET26_title.gif SET26_title.gif]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009031325/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/SET26_title.gif Internet Archive].

Facebook group search on 23 October 2026 (Bill Bisco session) did not turn up a full-size cinematic Virtual Set 26 release banner.
